description: This file defines the ScssHelper class providing methods to process SCSS styles such as darkening, lightening, RGBA conversion, and color validation, utilizing the ScssPhp compiler.

classes.name: ScssHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to compile and manipulate SCSS color styles, including darken, lighten, rgba, and color validation.

methods.name: getNewCompiler
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SCSS compiler instance with compressed output style.

methods.name: darken
methods.description: Darkens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS's darken function.

methods.name: lighten
methods.description: Lightens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS's lighten function.

methods.name: rgba
methods.description: Converts a color to its RGBA representation with a specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: isValidColor
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid color by attempting to lighten it; returns true if valid, false otherwise.
